content: The management of dyslipidemia is a critical component in addressing neuropathy associated with type 2 diabetes, as abnormal lipid levels significantly contribute to the development and progression of neuropathy. While controlling lipid levels may theoretically help mitigate the progression of neuropathy, conventional lipid-lowering medications, such as statins, have not demonstrated efficacy in preventing neuropathy. Instead, interventions such as regular physical activity and achieving weight loss may provide more substantial benefits in reducing the risk or progression of neuropathy in individuals with type 2 diabetes.
